svg.title: Frieren pearl master — moving foliate group selections
svg.desc: Authored polygons subdividing the frieren-pearl-ornaments.svg sculpture selection into coherent articulated leaf groups per corner (at most six). Each polygon is a generous ENVELOPE that tiles its corner canvas: the effective group coverage is the intersection with the ornament selection minus the fixed set (pearl body, sockets, red gems, corner setting ball, bead-pendant chain corridors, fixed root leaf and pivot collars), so the exact outer silhouette comes from the ornament mask and no leaf pixel can fall between envelopes. Groups share divider edges exactly, so the partition has no gaps and no double owners. Right-hand corners mirror the left about x=737 (x' = 1474 - x) and still sample each side's own source pixels. data-pivot is the attachment root in SOURCE coordinates; data-desc documents the group.
